# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the test run.
#
# The mini-SDK test double (core-service-layers-testing, mini-sdk/ios/Sources/Approov/Approov.m) keeps its state in
# nonatomic properties of MPState that it writes from every thread calling Approov.fetchTokenAndWait, so concurrent
# token fetches race inside the test double itself. This does not involve the service layer, and the production
# Approov SDK is not used by the tests. Remove this once the mini-SDK synchronizes MPState.
race:MPState
